To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Follow-Me concept is a novel approach that enables smooth migration and continuity of IP services and applications between DCs and UEs of 3GPP networks, without service disruption, by means of service identification and mapping logic.
Follow-Me Cloud is a concept that supports smooth migration and continuity of IP services and applications in a federated cloud environment.

the Follow-Me-Cloud concept can support smooth migration of all IP services or only a required part thereof between a data center (DC) and a user equipment (UE) of a 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) mobile network to another DC with no service interruption.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How do we ensure smooth service migration and continuity when an FMC service is delivered to a mobile user in a 3G cloud?

the design, implementation and performance analysis of the FMC concept, which is expected to enable the mobile network to offload traffic from its own DC to the cloud DCs, thus reducing costs, and to enable the cloud service providers to provide their services to the mobile users in a more cost-effective way.
the following: (i) a novel approach to service migration in FMC; (ii) a framework for FMC service migration; and (iii) a prototype of the framework for proof-of-concept.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

FMC is a novel approach to interworking federated cloud and distributed mobile networks, which is aimed at providing a smooth migration and continuity of IP service between a DC and a 3G mobile network, and between different DCs and mobile networks.
the Follow-Me concept and its framework is aimed at enabling a smooth and seamless migration of a cloud service from one data center to another data center without any disruption of the service.

the proposed framework is aimed to enable a smooth migration of an ongoing IP session from a data center to another data center or to a mobile network, or from a mobile network to another mobile network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Follow-Me Cloud is an approach to provide service mobility and continuity in a federated cloud environment.
Follow-Me Cloud is a concept of service continuity in a cloud environment, which is supported by a novel service/application identification and mapping logic.
we have proposed an architecture for the Follow-Me cloud concept, which is based on the use of the service identification and session ID.
The main takeaway from our work is that
service continuity is supported by a unique session/service ID that is independent of the IP address and the DC.
the FMC service/application identification, which is based on the UE and the cloud service IDs, is a powerful tool for supporting smooth service migration and continuity.
service continuity is supported by the FMC concept and its framework, which is a key requirement for the success of 5G.
